mission: Keep Ben's close POV while Desh executes the physical sabotage. The reader experiences Desh's operation through Ben's resonance-stressed infrastructure sense, comm bursts, node telemetry, and the array's physical response. The Ash-Tithe Compact becomes real opposition, and Desh's non-Force competence completes stage one of Veraine's defeat.
why_now: Stage one of Veraine's defeat. The resonance cannot defeat the amplified ritual alone; Desh strips the amplification and the physics change. The two-pronged plan works because both hands are on it, but the book's single-POV discipline should not break in the climax.
conflict: Ben must hold the resonance while trusting action he cannot directly control. Desh is off-site against armed Ash-Tithe opposition: hired guards at the first node, Mira's fearful Force-sensitive calibration at the second, and Pira Kul's reinforced technical command at the third. The pressure is time: three nodes before the resonance fails, with no margin for Ben to verify the work himself.
turning_point: Third node dark. The array drops below threshold. Desh's comm reaches Ben through static: 'Array's down. Whatever you're doing - do it now. Everything. Don't hold back.'
opening_hook: The first node is only a point of tension in Ben's chest until Desh's comm clicks twice and the point goes dark.
closing_hook: The third node goes dark. Desh's voice cuts through the static: 'Array's down. Whatever you're doing - do it now. Everything. Don't hold back.'
emotional_trajectory: Forced trust -> escalating off-site danger -> handoff through competence

stakes.personal: Ben cannot solve the practical half of the climax with Force-sense; he has to trust Desh's hands
stakes.interpersonal: Desh and Ben's partnership - the mystical and the practical on the same operation without either one becoming decorative
stakes.external: Without the array, Veraine cannot breach. Stage one of her defeat must complete before the resonance can become more than desperate resistance.

setting: Veranthos - resonance position at mid-valley, with comm and telemetry from Desh's off-site amplification-node run
sensory_details: Ben's resonance hold making the three critical nodes feel like hard knots in the valley's field; Desh's comm reduced to breath, clicks, and clipped tactical facts; node equipment sparking across telemetry instead of through Desh interiority; Ash-Tithe signatures distinct in the array: hired guards as movement noise, Mira's faint Force-sensitive flinch at a calibration lock, Pira Kul's pressure-cut countersequence at the final node; Sera's lock-sense pulling against Ben's left side; Kael's unintegrable signature bracing the right; Veraine's ritual still amplified until each knot goes dark
canon_elements_needed: Single-POV Ben discipline for climax rendering
Non-Force operative contribution through comms, telemetry, and infrastructure effects
action_beats: Ben holds the resonance with Sera and Kael while the first node remains a hard knot in the array; Desh's comm clicks twice and the knot goes dark
Desh's first clipped report confirms nonlethal takedowns on hired guards and equipment disabled, giving Ben facts without shifting into Desh interiority
At the second node, Mira's low Force-sensitive calibration touch flares against Ben's infrastructure sense; Desh breaks the control housing before that warning becomes useful to Veraine

The third node resists: Pira Kul has reinforced the control housing and is directing guards with professional calm; Ben hears blaster static and a cut-off grunt through the comm but cannot leave the resonance
The third node goes dark. Desh reports Pira alive and contained, then gives Ben the handoff: array down, do it now, everything
Ben stops trying to verify Desh's success and lets the changed physics become part of the resonance
notes: This is Desh's operational triumph, but not Desh POV. Do not cut into Desh's thoughts, breathing-as-interiority, or visual camera unless a device feed explicitly carries it to Ben. Keep the GAG history present as technique visible through results: nonlethal reports, timing, controlled violence, and equipment going dark. Pira should survive as technical evidence. Mira should feel dangerous because she can warn the system, not because she is suddenly a Sith combatant. The hired guards are obstacles, not character subplots.

turning_point_detail.trigger: Third amplification node goes dark; Desh confirms Pira Kul alive and contained, and the array drops below operational threshold.
turning_point_detail.shift: The amplification infrastructure collapses. Veraine's ritual loses its force-multiplication. Ben's resonance work transitions from impossible to merely desperate. The scene's pressure transfers from Desh's operational timeline to Ben's mystical one without leaving Ben's POV.
turning_point_detail.cost: Ben has to accept a result he did not personally verify. Desh has burned his cover and nonlethal discipline to the limit. The handoff arrives with no margin: do it now, everything, do not hold back.

emotional_arc.start: Forced trust - Ben feels the nodes as hard knots but cannot leave the resonance to help or verify.
emotional_arc.shift: Escalating off-site danger as each node reveals a different Ash-Tithe threat and Ben's only access is comm, telemetry, and the array's changing pressure.
emotional_arc.end: Handoff through competence - the third node dark, the array stripped, Desh's voice steady enough to make the next impossible thing Ben's problem.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben holds the resonance with Sera and Kael while the first node remains a hard knot in the array. Desh's comm clicks twice. The knot goes dark.
key_beats.state_change: The abstract operational pressure becomes concrete and measurable from Ben's POV. One node is down without Ben controlling it.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's instinct reaches to verify, but the resonance slips when he tries. He has to take the darkened node as fact because Desh made it fact.

key_beats.beat_description: Desh's clipped report confirms nonlethal takedowns on hired guards and equipment disabled. He gives facts, not drama, and moves before Ben can answer.
key_beats.state_change: Desh's old GAG skill is visible as result and restraint: guards alive, equipment broken, no wasted motion.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben feels the quiet moral line in the report. Break equipment, not people. He cannot praise it; he can only keep holding.

key_beats.beat_description: At the second node, Mira Dann's low Force-sensitive calibration touch flares against Ben's infrastructure sense. Desh breaks the control housing before the warning can travel cleanly through the array.
key_beats.state_change: The crew's threat diversifies. Mira is not generic muscle; she is a frightened, useful sensor in Veraine's system.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben registers the flare like a hand tapping the wrong side of glass. He cannot reach Mira, cannot argue with her fear, and cannot let her warning save the node.

key_beats.beat_description: The third node resists. Pira Kul has reinforced the control housing and is directing guards with professional calm. Ben hears blaster static and a cut-off grunt through the comm while the knot refuses to go dark.
key_beats.state_change: The final node becomes the real physical obstacle. Veraine's array is defended by competence, not faceless bodies.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's concentration tears toward the sound and Sera catches the resonance edge before it slips. He cannot go to Desh. Trust becomes an action, not a feeling.

key_beats.beat_description: The third node goes dark. Desh reports Pira alive and contained, then gives the handoff: 'Array's down. Whatever you're doing - do it now. Everything. Don't hold back.'
key_beats.state_change: The tactical prong of the plan is complete. Veraine's amplification drops below threshold. The mystical prong must now execute without margin.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben stops trying to verify Desh's success and lets the changed physics become part of the resonance. The trust he could not force becomes the condition of the next move.

anti_patterns: Do not switch into Desh POV even though the scene pays off Desh's role.
Do not open with a flashback to GAG history or training; the history is present as technique and result.
No lethal kills unless absolutely required; Desh's read is break equipment, not people.
Do not slow the action for exposition about how the amplification nodes work; understanding should emerge through node response, comm facts, and Ben's infrastructure sense.
Do not make Ash-Tithe members crowd Veraine out of the climax; they are pressure, evidence, and facets of her leadership.
